main_measure.name: slope of drift-adjusted 10-bar forward return on forecast

statistic.name: OLS t, standard errors clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: slope positive with t >= 2 (and carry on both sides) to confirm; negative with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: carry on both sides: smaller of long mean and sign-flipped short mean drift-adjusted 10-bar return, must be > 0

reading: Drift is the coin's mean 10-bar return on the non-overlapping grid of all its windows; 'cases on the same day together' is read as day-clustered standard errors of the OLS slope (with intercept); the supporting check is the sign of each side's mean; a minimum count not reached gives 'not observable'.
